texts.li: {A_nameDef} has come of age, and the colony is asking what comes next. {B_nameDef}, the best hands in the workshop, has offered to take {A_objective} on.\n\n{A_nameDef} hasn't said what {A_pronoun} wants. Nobody has asked yet.
{A_nameDef} is grown now. {B_nameDef} has been watching {A_objective} fiddle with broken things for years and says there's a crafter in there.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in crafting
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} starts in the workshop tomorrow. {B_nameDef} has already set aside a bench.

li.label: Put {A_nameDef} on the defenses
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} spends the next weeks on the range and the wall. The colony is safer. {A_nameDef} is tired.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: The council asked {A_nameDef} what {A_pronoun} wanted. It took a while to answer. It was a good answer.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has come of age. {B_nameDef} says the colony will need another healer before long, and that {A_nameDef} has steady hands.\n\nIt's a hard trade to learn. People die while you learn it.
{A_nameDef} is grown, and {B_nameDef} wants an apprentice in the infirmary. "I won't live forever," {B_nameDef} told the council. "Nobody here does."

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in medicine
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} now follows {B_nameDef} on every round of the sickbeds, taking notes.

li.label: The fields need hands more
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is sent to the fields. The harvest will be better. {B_nameDef} goes on alone.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} was asked, and thanked the council for asking.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has come of age, and {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} at the research bench. "There's a mind in there," {B_nameDef} says, "and it's wasted hauling rocks."
{A_nameDef} is grown. {B_nameDef} has offered to teach {A_objective} everything {B_pronoun} knows about the old technologies.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in study
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} spends the evenings with {B_nameDef} and a stack of salvaged books.

li.label: Hands before books
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is put to construction. The walls go up faster. {B_nameDef} sulks.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has come of age. {B_nameDef}, the colony's best shot, says {A_nameDef} has the eye for it and should start training now, before the next raid.\n\nOthers say {A_nameDef} has seen enough fighting for a lifetime already.
{A_nameDef} is grown, and wants to stand on the wall with the others. {B_nameDef} has offered to teach. Not everyone thinks that's a good idea.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} at arms
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is on the range at dawn every day now, with {B_nameDef} standing behind, correcting.

li.label: No. Not this one, not yet
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is kept off the wall. {A_nameDef} is furious. Some of the parents are relieved.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: The council left it to {A_nameDef}. Everyone is waiting to see what {A_pronoun} decides.
